返回码: 0耗时: 1s
pytest 9.0.2 Python 3.11.4 pip 25.3
容器内 Python 安装在 /opt/buildtools/python-3.11.4 自定义路径, 简称未默认暴露. 链接到 /usr/local/bin 即可在 PATH 中可见.
action
修复容器内 Python/pip/pytest 可执行文件不在 PATH 的问题, 创建符号链接
result
成功. 创建 /usr/local/bin/{python,pytest,pip,pip3} 符号链接指向 /opt/buildtools/python-3.11.4/bin/. presmoke.sh 使用 'command -v pytest' 和 'python -m pytest' 检查, 原 PATH 仅含 /opt/buildtools/python-3.11.4/bin (不暴露 python/pytest/pip 简称). 创建链接后 pytest 9.0.2, python 3.11.4, pip 25.3 均可用.
details
3 个字段
issue
presmoke.sh line 46-47: command -v pytest 失败, python -m pytest 失败 (python 不存在)
fix
ln -sf /opt/buildtools/python-3.11.4/bin/python3 /usr/local/bin/python; ln -sf /opt/buildtools/python-3.11.4/bin/pytest /usr/local/bin/pytest; ln -sf /opt/buildtools/python-3.11.4/bin/pip3 /usr/local/bin/pip; ln -sf /opt/buildtools/python-3.11.4/bin/pip3 /usr/local/bin/pip3
verified
pytest --version -> 9.0.2; python --version -> 3.11.4; pip --version -> 25.3

build_commands
2 个字段
source
aura/setup.py + contributing.md 5.2 节 (CI 镜像无需 pip install -e .) + script/aura_ut.sh (pre_install 函数自装依赖)
value
本仓库为 Python 框架 (无传统编译产物). CI 镜像 (mindx_arm:SDK_20260112_1) 已具备全部基础环境, contributing.md 明确 '无需执行 pip install -e .'. build 步骤等同于 'install + import 验证': cd /workspace/AgentSDK/aura && python3 -c 'import aura; print(aura.__file__)'. 若需手动安装: cd /workspace/AgentSDK/aura && pip install -e . (setup.py name=aura version=5.0.0 python_requires='>=3.11'). 注意: aura_ut.sh 的 pre_install 函数会自动安装 UT 所需的 CPU 版本依赖 (torch==2.5.1, torchvision==0.20.1, transformers==4.52.3 等), 与 Dockerfile 的 NPU 版本不同.
ut_commands
2 个字段
source
contributing.md 5.3 节 + script/aura_ut.sh
value
bash script/aura_ut.sh [http_proxy] [https_proxy] (脚本会自动 pre_install 依赖 + 克隆 rLLM v0.1 到 aura/third-party/rllm/ + 设置 PYTHONPATH + 运行 'python3 -m pytest --cov=aura/ --cov-report=term --cov-report=html --cov-report=xml --junit-xml --html --self-contained-html --cov-branch -vs tests/'); 工作目录: /workspace/AgentSDK (脚本顶部 workdir=.../.. 计算后位于仓库根); 需要预装 pytest/pytest-html/pytest-cov
sample_commands
2 个字段
source
contributing.md 5.3 节 + run_presmoke_aura.sh + presmoke/aura/presmoke.sh
value
bash run_presmoke_aura.sh (调用 presmoke/aura/presmoke.sh); presmoke.sh 内部: pip install mlflow + ray==2.55.1; apt update + apt install net-tools iproute2; export PYTHONPATH=$PROJECT_ROOT/aura; 自动探测 LOCAL_IP 与 DEFAULT_SOCKET_IFNAME; 运行 'pytest presmoke/aura/cases/test_endtoend.py -v --tb=short' (10 个端到端用例)

    result
    成功. 创建 /usr/local/bin/{python,pytest,pip,pip3} 符号链接指向 /opt/buildtools/python-3.11.4/bin/. presmoke.sh 使用 'command -v pytest' 和 'python -m pytest' 检查, 原 PATH 仅含 /opt/buildtools/python-3.11.4/bin (不暴露 python/pytest/pip 简称). 创建链接后 pytest 9.0.2, python 3.11.4, pip 25.3 均可用.
    details
    3 个字段
    issue
    presmoke.sh line 46-47: command -v pytest 失败, python -m pytest 失败 (python 不存在)
    fix
    ln -sf /opt/buildtools/python-3.11.4/bin/python3 /usr/local/bin/python; ln -sf /opt/buildtools/python-3.11.4/bin/pytest /usr/local/bin/pytest; ln -sf /opt/buildtools/python-3.11.4/bin/pip3 /usr/local/bin/pip; ln -sf /opt/buildtools/python-3.11.4/bin/pip3 /usr/local/bin/pip3
    verified
    pytest --version -> 9.0.2; python --version -> 3.11.4; pip --version -> 25.3
    command
    docker exec AgentSDK-ttfhw bash -c 'ln -sf /opt/buildtools/python-3.11.4/bin/python3 /usr/local/bin/python && ln -sf /opt/buildtools/python-3.11.4/bin/pytest /usr/local/bin/pytest && ln -sf /opt/buildtools/python-3.11.4/bin/pip3 /usr/local/bin/pip && ln -sf /opt/buildtools/python-3.11.4/bin/pip3 /usr/local/bin/pip3'
    success
    true
    output
    pytest 9.0.2 Python 3.11.4 pip 25.3
    error
